mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months indicates economic weakness, which leads to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals robust economic activity and strong corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE is below 4% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real personal savings (RSAFS) indicates consumer confidence and future spending potential, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS is high.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and increasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.3% and PAYEMS declines by more than 100k.
